purpose: Distinguish intentional semantic overlay views from illegal emitted-range overlap.

container.name: LEVEL_F800_TILEMAP_SOURCE
container.consumer: VDP_CopyLevelF800Tilemap copies 0x400 words to VRAM F800.

view.name: ACTOR_SPRITE_VRAM_BASE_TABLE
view.consumer: Actor_AllocateSpriteVRAM indexes 117 longwords for actor sprite tile bases.

overlays.interpretation: The actor table is a child semantic view over bytes also included in the level F800 transfer source; layout emission gives the child view ownership of those bytes while retaining the container range as an analysis alias.

view.name: MENU_PALETTE_BAND_SOURCE_129012
view.consumer: Menu_RunOptionsAndSelectNextState uploads one fixed palette band.

overlays.interpretation: The fixed menu band is a direct view of one band inside the four-band transition source.

container.name: LEVEL_PALETTE_SOURCE_STATE_00_02
container.consumer: Scene_ApplyActiveLevelPaletteTransition consumes four bands for level states 00 and 02.

view.name: LEVEL00_PALETTE_BAND_SOURCE
view.consumer: Level00_EnterRoutine uploads one fixed palette band.

overlays.interpretation: The Level 00 fixed band is a direct view of one band inside the shared level transition source.

container.name: LEVEL_PALETTE_SOURCE_STATE_05_06
container.consumer: Scene_ApplyActiveLevelPaletteTransition consumes four bands for level states 05 and 06.

view.name: INTERACTION_PALETTE_SOURCE_1292B2
view.consumer: Type-0x05 and related interaction/level-event spawners upload one fixed palette band.

overlays.interpretation: The interaction palette is a direct view of one band inside the shared level transition source.

container.name: LEVEL_PALETTE_SOURCE_STATE_10
container.consumer: Scene_ApplyActiveLevelPaletteTransition consumes four bands for level state 10.

view.name: INTERACTION_TYPE0C_PALETTE_SOURCE
view.consumer: The Type-0x0C/0x3C interaction handler family uploads one fixed palette band.

overlays.interpretation: The Type-0x0C palette is a direct view of one band inside the level-state transition source.

validation: The five overlays are declared at distinct addresses and are not emitted as overlapping layout ranges.
genie layout validate reports complete gap-free ownership.
genie deasm verify remains byte-exact after the overlay views are applied.
conclusion: These five canonical range overlaps are intentional container/view aliases. They must remain representable in the symbol database while the layout and generated deassembly maintain exactly one emitted owner for every ROM byte.
